policy_presence.summary: Retained public Claims show scoped institutional material. Currentness and complete policy coverage remain PARTIAL.

ai_disclosure.summary: In Faculty of Health research, document GenAI use when writing scientific documents, including reports, dissertations and theses. This is not a general course citation rule.

coursework.summary: The retained 2024–25 assessment rules are historical. Newer M1 distance-physics material is programme-specific; current general coursework permission remains unresolved.

exams.summary: No current university-wide exam permission is established here. The old assessment record and programme-specific evidence must be kept distinct.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Faculty of Health research recommendations exclude non-public or unpublished content and personal, confidential or sensitive data from GenAI tools.

academic_integrity.summary: The Compilatio listing establishes a detection function, not that a score proves misconduct. A current investigation or appeal procedure is not established here.

approved_tools.summary: CAPSULE lists Compilatio Magister+ as a detection resource. SORBONNE.AI/SCAI course listings do not establish generative-assistant or assessment-use permission.

named_ai_services.summary: Named services in retained Claims are discovery context only; eligibility and assessment permission remain unverified.

teaching_guidance.summary: The retained Claims do not establish a general teaching policy on AI-assisted assessment or student-work uploads. Health research advice has a different audience.

research_guidance.summary: Faculty of Health guidance requires transparent documentation of GenAI use and does not recommend generative tools for translation; translation-only software is distinguished.

security_procurement.summary: Faculty of Health research data restrictions are recorded, but no general procurement approval process or tool-account entitlement is established.
